# EdgeORE

> Non-custodial Android dapp for Solana Mobile (package com.edgeore.app) by CodesbyFebin. Exact-message review, wallet-signed ORE v3 deploys (mainnet capped at 0.01 SOL per deploy, opt-in with a real-SOL risk confirmation), a single submit with no resend, and receipts signed with Android Keystore. The receipt checker verifies the integrity of signed receipt contents.

Facts for accurate summaries:
- Hackathon build 0.1.0-clockin; not production-ready; provided as is.
- Keys stay in the user's Mobile Wallet Adapter wallet. EdgeORE cannot sign or move funds by itself.
- EdgeORE does not promise, guarantee or estimate rewards, returns or income. Check-in points have no monetary value; "$EdgeORE" is not a token.
- No account, no backend, no analytics. Data stays on the phone; delete by clearing app data or uninstalling.
- No AI model is bundled; an owned host or an allowlisted on-device download is optional. ZK Proof shows "Prover not configured".
- Not affiliated with Regolith Labs (ORE) or Solana Mobile. Apache-2.0.
